title: StealthGuard-402 Input
description: Input parameters for StealthGuard-402 tools including stealth scraping, Polymarket alpha divergence, and on-chain pre-trade agent gating.

tool.title: Tool to Execute
tool.description: Select which StealthGuard tool pipeline to run

extract_schema.title: Extract Schema
extract_schema.description: Optional JSON schema specifying structured fields to extract from DOM

render_js.title: Render JavaScript
render_js.description: Activate Patchright/Playwright stealth headless browser for Cloudflare Turnstile / SPAs

category.title: Polymarket Category
category.description: Optional category filter for polymarket_alpha_divergence (e.g. crypto, politics)

limit.title: Market Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of top-volume active prediction markets to scan (1-50)

token_or_service_address.title: Token / Service Address
token_or_service_address.description: Contract address or x402 resource address for pre_trade_agent_gate

target_url.title: Token Website URL
target_url.description: Optional associated website URL to scrape and audit for prompt injection

strict_mode.title: Strict Mode
strict_mode.description: If true, blocks content entirely upon prompt injection; if false, redacts detected instructions
